purpose: Exploded view showing 6 structural layers: fabric shell, LED ring, speaker, PCB, inner shell, wood base
prompt:
Industrial design exploded view technical illustration of an elderly AI companion device, showing all internal structural layers separated vertically with even spacing. Warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

The device is a pebble shape, approximately 130mm wide x 170mm tall. Show 6 layers exploded vertically from top to bottom, each layer floating with even spacing (about 30mm gap between each):

Layer 1 (top): "Fabric Shell" — The cream-colored (#F5F0E8) acoustic-transparent fabric cover, shown as a hollow sleeve/sock shape. Semi-transparent to show it's a textile. Soft, flexible appearance.

Layer 2: "LED Light Guide Ring" — A ring-shaped translucent diffuser in warm amber tint (#E8B87A at 30% opacity). Frosted material, donut-shaped. This sits at the upper third of the device.

Layer 3: "Speaker Module" — A circular 40mm speaker driver with a warm gray (#D4CFC7) frame. Show the cone, magnet, and frame. Behind it, 3 small microphone PCBs arranged in a triangle (mic array).

Layer 4: "Main PCB + Battery" — A circular printed circuit board (green-ish but warm-toned) with components visible. Below it, a flat lithium-polymer battery pack in warm gray pouch. Show connector cables.

Layer 5: "Inner Shell" — The hard plastic internal frame in warm gray (#D4CFC7), matte finish. Provides structural support. Shows mounting points and cable routing channels.

Layer 6 (bottom): "Wood Base" — The light oak wood base ring (#C4A882) with magnetic charging contacts (gold-colored pogo pins) on top surface and anti-slip silicone pad on bottom.

A thin vertical dashed line connects all layers through their center axis, showing alignment. Clean technical illustration style with warm tones. No cold blue or clinical white. Text-charcoal (#3D3832) labels with thin leader lines. Professional engineering visualization.
